name: ai-career-preparation
description: AI Career Preparation SaaS MVP - resume analysis, skill gap reports and AI interview practice

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @career-prep/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @career-prep/api" "npm run dev -w @career-prep/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @career-prep/shared && npm run build -w @career-prep/api && npm run build -w @career-prep/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @career-prep/shared && npm run typecheck -w @career-prep/api && npm run typecheck -w @career-prep/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @career-prep/shared && npm run test -w @career-prep/api && npm run test -w @career-prep/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w @career-prep/shared && npm run test:unit -w @career-prep/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @career-prep/shared && npm run test:integration -w @career-prep/api
